pages.title: Mass Spectrometer
pages.text: Ions shot through a magnetic field: the heavy ones bend less. Set the field and only one mass reaches the detector.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the magnetic field and the accelerating voltage. Ions bend on r = √(2mV/q)/B; the detector sits at 0.5 m, so each target mass needs its own field. The magnet reaches 1.5 T.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Deuterium, Lithium-6 Ingot.
